title: IoT Fleet Management System
description: Real-time vehicle tracking, route optimization, and fleet analytics using GPS modules and a cloud dashboard. Built for a Pakistan Army deployment during an internship at RDC & CEAI, NUST.

title: EEG Signal Cleaning & Analysis
description: Signal processing pipeline for cleaning noisy EEG data using adaptive filtering, ICA, and spectral analysis for brain-computer interface applications.

title: 4-bit ALU Design
description: Arithmetic Logic Unit designed from gate level up, supporting arithmetic and logical operations with carry lookahead for high-speed computation.

title: FM Receiver Circuit
description: Working FM radio receiver built from scratch using LC tuning circuits, RF amplifiers, and demodulation stages (TDA7000) on a breadboard/custom PCB.

title: Dual-Axis Solar Tracker
description: Dual-axis solar tracking system using LDR sensors and servo motors to maximize panel efficiency throughout the day with automatic positioning.

title: ML Predictive Models
description: Regression, classification, and clustering models built and deployed during the FlyRank / CodeAlpha ML internships.

title: EV Charging Station
description: ESP32-based EV charging station with a full state machine, current/temperature sensing, relay control, and energy accumulation, simulated in Proteus ISIS.

title: SDR-Based UAV Detection
description: Final year project combining RF detection with an ML classifier for identifying UAV signals.
